## What appears wrong?

Describe what the image shows and whether the concern is the source file, decoded frame number, crop, transition, or assignment.

## Frame context

Include the exact source filename, decoded frame number, timestamp, glyph position, matched glyph, and difference cells. The explorer's report link fills these in automatically.

## Supporting evidence

State any nearby frames or independently hashed variants you checked. Do not upload copyrighted source video unless you have permission.
